name: Apart Isabelle
beschreibung: The Apart Isabelle is a holiday apartment located in Ischgl, Tyrol. The property is within walking distance of the Silvretta Cable Car and the town center. The apartment features a kitchenette, a bedroom, and a bathroom. A ski storage cellar and complimentary Wi-Fi are provided. Dedicated on-site car parking is also available. The accommodation is designed for two to four guests. The interior is practical and comfortable. Guests can look forward to a peaceful location with scenic mountain views.
